items.title: Tre Lamb discusses coaching carousel, emphasizes Tulsa's potential
items.summary: Tulsa coach Tre Lamb addressed coaching carousel speculation following TCU's coaching change, emphasizing his goals and the Golden Hurricane's potential.

items.title: Tulsa announces largest apparel deal in school history
items.summary: Tulsa Athletics has announced the largest apparel deal in school history, renewing its adidas partnership and naming Game One its official supplier.

items.title: WATCH: Tre Lamb Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: Tulsa Head Football Coach Tre Lamb met with the media Monday as the Golden Hurricane prepares to travel to San Antonio, Texas, for its regular-season finale against UTSA on Friday, Nov. 27.

items.title: Hayes Named Manning Award Star of the Week for Second Time
items.summary: Tulsa quarterback Baylor Hayes has been named one of eight Manning Award Stars of the Week for the second time this season following his five-touchdown performance in the Golden Hurricane's 42-14 victory over Charlotte on Saturday, Nov. 21.

items.title: Tulsa Hurricane Coaches Show Airs Tonight Live from Elgin Park
items.summary: The Tulsa Football Coaches Show, presented by Western Sun Federal Credit Union, featuring Head Coach Tre Lamb, airs live tonight, Monday, Nov. 23, at its new start time of 6 p.m. from Elgin Park in downtown Tulsa.

items.title: Tulsa overcomes slow start to rout Charlotte 42-14
items.summary: Tulsa scored 35 consecutive points to beat Charlotte 42-14, securing its first winning season since 2021 behind ManMan Singleton's three touchdowns.

items.title: Tulsa Earns Seventh Victory of the Season with Win over Charlotte
items.summary: Tulsa defeated Charlotte 42-14 on Saturday at H.A. Chapman Stadium, scoring 35 unanswered points after falling behind 14-7. Tulsa finished with 482 yards of offense, including 285 passing and 197 rushing.

items.title: Tulsa looks to avoid complacency against Charlotte
items.summary: Tulsa looks to extend its winning streak against Charlotte, avoid complacency and secure a winning season with a victory at H.A. Chapman Stadium.

items.title: Tre Lamb eyes 8-win mark, praises defensive grit
items.summary: Bowl-eligible Tulsa eyes its second 8-win season in 14 years. Coach Tre Lamb talks D-line retention, and Charlotte in our notebook.

items.title: Trysten Shaw's explosive senior season shows what Tulsa is getting
items.summary: Tulsa commit Trysten Shaw has 1,178 receiving yards and 25 touchdowns in a dominant senior season at Mansfield Timberview in Texas.

items.title: Tulsa Hosts Charlotte Saturday in Regular-Season Home Finale
items.summary: Tulsa hosts Charlotte on Saturday, Nov. 21, in its final home game of the regular season. Kickoff is scheduled for 1 p.m. CT on ESPN+.

items.title: Tailgate Experience Set for Charlotte
items.summary: Tulsa fans can begin Saturday's football festivities at Chapman Commons, where the Golden Hurricane Tailgate will feature live music, food, drinks and family-friendly activities ahead of the Golden Hurricane's final home game of the 2026 season against Charlotte.

items.title: WATCH: Tre Lamb Previews Tulsa's Matchup Against Charlotte
items.summary: Tulsa Head Football Coach Tre Lamb met with the media Monday as the Golden Hurricane prepares to host Charlotte in its final home game of the 2026 season Saturday at H.A. Chapman Stadium.

items.title: Tulsa Football's Kickoff Time and Television Network Announced for UTSA Game
items.summary: The American Conference has announced the kickoff time and television network for Tulsa's regular-season finale at UTSA.

items.title: Tulsa lands commitment from Edmond Santa Fe CB Sean-Cole Keyes
items.summary: Edmond Santa Fe cornerback Sean-Cole Keyes commits to Tulsa after an official visit, bringing 4.39 speed and an impressive senior season.

items.title: Tulsa dominates Florida Atlantic 38-21 to become bowl eligible
items.summary: Tulsa defeated Florida Atlantic 38-21 to become bowl eligible for the first time since 2021, powered by a dominant defensive effort and explosive plays.

items.title: Tulsa Clinches Bowl Eligibility in 38-21 Win Over FAU
items.summary: Tulsa Football is bowl eligible for the first time since 2021 after a 38-21 Homecoming win over Florida Atlantic on Saturday night. Tulsa finished with 309 passing yards and 192 rushing yards and scored touchdowns on all three red-zone trips. This was Tulsa's 56th win on Homecoming and the first since the 2024 season.

items.title: Tulsa looks to build on Tulane rout against high-scoring Florida Atlantic
items.summary: Tulsa looks to build on its 60-10 win over Tulane as Baylor Hayes and the Golden Hurricane host high-scoring Florida Atlantic for Homecoming.

items.title: Tulsa Hosts Florida Atlantic For Homecoming
items.summary: Tulsa hosts Florida Atlantic for Homecoming on Saturday, Nov. 14, at H.A. Chapman Stadium. Kickoff is set for 2:30 p.m. CT on ESPN+. It will be the 101st Homecoming game in program history.

items.title: Baylor Hayes heating up at the right time for Tulsa
items.summary: Baylor Hayes threw for a career-high 338 yards and 4 TDs in Tulsa's win at Tulane. Now the Golden Hurricane QB looks to keep rolling against FAU.

items.title: Tulsa put on a show in stunning 60-10 rout of Tulane
items.summary: Tulsa football dominated Tulane 60-10 behind Baylor Hayes' 338 yards and 4 touchdowns, Oran Singleton's 3 scores and a 6-sack defensive performance.

items.title: Tulsa's bowl hopes still alive as Golden Hurricane visit Tulane
items.summary: Tulsa visits Tulane as the Hurricane look to turn close losses into wins and keep bowl eligibility hopes alive. Get the full matchup preview.
